articles.title: Driver facing impaired driving charges following 3 vehicle crash in Scarborough
articles.summary: One person is facing impaired driving charges following a three-vehicle crash in Scarborough.

articles.title: Toronto Pearson airport, Seneca Polytechnic form partnership to connect students with in-demand jobs
articles.summary: Toronto Pearson airport staff are looking to connect Seneca students with aviation, construction, office, operations and maintenance jobs.

articles.title: Is this Toronto's spookiest street? Meet the skeleton's of Pape Avenue
articles.summary: Houses along Pape Avenue, north of Queen East, are covered in skeletons posing in grand, creative, larger-than-life displays. CBC's Haydn Watters finds why the neighbourhood is so obsessed with skulls and bones.

articles.title: Motorcyclist seriously injured in Mississauga crash
articles.summary: A motorcyclist was rushed to a trauma centre on Friday evening following a serious crash in Mississauga. Emergency crews were called to the area of Financial Drive and Derry Road just after 8:30 p.m. for reports of a two-vehicle collision. articles.title: York Catholic school board chair contributed to ‘toxic environment': board’s integrity commissioner
articles.summary: The integrity commissioner for the York Catholic District School Board is taking disciplinary action against the board’s chair after an investigation fund she used “profane” language towards the former education director.

articles.title: Mississauga mayor-elect unveils transition team
articles.summary: Just days after his sizeable victory, mayor-elect Alvin Tedjo has unveiled the list of people who have joined his transition team as he prepares to take over the role of mayor from Carolyn Parrish in November.

articles.title: Police arrest dump truck driver in collision that killed Toronto traffic agent
articles.summary: Police say they've arrested and charged 33-year-old Brampton man in a collision that killed a Toronto traffic agent on Thursday.

articles.title: OPP officer charged with assault after Caledon man injured in arrest: SIU
articles.summary: An Ontario Provinical Police officer who was involved in an arrest that left a man seriously injured in Caledon last year has been charged with assault.

articles.title: Ontario government completes bike lane removal on section of Bloor Street W.
articles.summary: Bike lanes on a 1.2-kilometre stretch of Bloor Street West have been completely removed, according to the province Friday. It comes just weeks after dozens of residents came together in Etobicoke to protest the removal, which is the first part of Ontario's plan to rip out bike lanes on three major roads in Toronto.

articles.title: 'We've had enough': Condo owners rally at Queen's Park to call for change in how condo boards operate
articles.summary: A group of condo owners took their fight for legislative change to Queen's Park this week to demand reforms they say would protect the 1.9 million people in Ontario who live in condos.
